stories.title: Autoridades instalan tres puestos de mando ante llegada del Huracán Simón; podría tocar tierra en Puerto Vallarta en categoría 4

en.title: Authorities install three command posts ahead of Hurricane Simón arrival; could make landfall in Puerto Vallarta at Category 4
en.summary: Mexican military and national guard have deployed 800 personnel with additional elements to establish emergency response centers as Hurricane Simón approaches Puerto Vallarta.

stories.title: Huracán Simón deja inundaciones y mar de fondo en Acapulco a pocas horas de tocar tierra

en.title: Hurricane Simón causes flooding and rough seas in Acapulco hours before making landfall
en.summary: Hurricane Simón is bringing flooding and dangerous surf conditions to Acapulco while tracking northward toward Puerto Vallarta.

stories.title: Trump presionó en llamada a Sheinbaum por acuerdos energéticos y compras de gas natural a EU

en.title: Trump pressured Sheinbaum in call over energy agreements and natural gas purchases from US
en.summary: During a call with Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum, Donald Trump urged greater cooperation and agreements between Mexican and U.S. energy companies, according to the Financial Times.

stories.title: Trump presiona a México para que cierre acuerdos energéticos en negociaciones comerciales, reporta Financial Times

en.title: Trump pressures Mexico to close energy deals in trade negotiations, Financial Times reports
en.summary: Trump is pushing Mexico to finalize energy sector agreements as part of broader commercial negotiations.

stories.title: Trump anuncia que Putin se comprometió a suministrar diesel a EU; dice que también lo dará al mercado mundial

en.title: Trump announces that Putin committed to supplying diesel to US; says it will also go to global market
en.summary: Trump stated that Putin agreed to supply diesel to the United States and the broader global market. The Treasury Department indicated it would issue a temporary license.

stories.title: Sheinbaum reforzará el sistema penal en Sinaloa tras riña en penal de Mazatlán

en.title: Sheinbaum will strengthen the penal system in Sinaloa following prison riot in Mazatlán
en.summary: Following deaths of several inmates in a prison altercation, the president announced an investigation into the incident's origins while the state governor committed to constructing additional detention facilities as part of security measures.

stories.title: Fuerte sismo de magnitud 7.7 sacude Panamá; emiten alerta de tsunami en el Pacífico oriental

en.title: Powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake shakes Panama; tsunami alert issued for eastern Pacific
en.summary: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama after initial estimates of 8.0 and 7.6. Such seismic activity is unusual in the capital but occurs regularly in Chiriquí province.

stories.title: Fuerte sismo de 7.7 sacude a Panamá y provoca pánico en la capital; levantan alerta de tsunami en el Pacífico

en.title: Powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake shakes Panama and causes panic in capital; tsunami alert lifted in Pacific
en.summary: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama, causing alarm in the capital city before the subsequent tsunami alert was lifted from the Pacific region.

stories.title: Sacude sismo de magnitud 7.6 a Panamá

en.title: 7.6 magnitude earthquake strikes Panama
en.summary: A magnitude 7.6 earthquake occurred in Panama according to the U.S. Geological Survey.

stories.title: Presiona Trump a México por acuerdos energéticos, dice FT

en.title: Trump pressures Mexico on energy agreements, says FT
en.summary: Trump urged increased energy partnerships and agreements between Mexican and U.S. energy companies during a call with CSP, according to the Financial Times.

stories.title: Reportan nueva riña en penal de Mazatlán; hay dos internos muertos

en.title: New riot reported at Mazatlán prison; two inmates killed
en.summary: Two inmates died during a new disturbance at a prison facility in Mazatlán.

stories.title: Riña en penal de Sinaloa deja 9 reos y un menor muertos

en.title: Prison Fight in Sinaloa Leaves 9 Inmates and One Child Dead
en.summary: A riot at El Castillo penitentiary in Mazatlán, Sinaloa resulted in nine inmate deaths and one visiting two-year-old child killed, along with 16 other inmates injured.

stories.title: La deuda que la inteligencia artificial no puede pagar

en.title: The debt that artificial intelligence cannot pay
en.summary: Companies succeeding in AI transformation will be those questioning their existing foundations rather than simply implementing more artificial intelligence technology.

stories.title: ¿Quién es Navi Pillay, la Nobel de la Paz 2026 que incomoda a Trump y Netanyahu por su trabajo sobre Gaza?

en.title: Who is Navi Pillay, the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize winner who troubles Trump and Netanyahu over her work on Gaza?
en.summary: Navi Pillay, 2026 Nobel Peace Prize recipient, is a lawyer who defended political prisoners, investigated genocide crimes, and led investigations into Gaza that generated tensions with Israel.

stories.title: El menor gasto de México ayuda a contener el crecimiento del déficit fiscal

en.title: Mexico's lower spending helps contain fiscal deficit growth
en.summary: Lower budget spending in Mexico during the 2026 fiscal year helps limit deficit increases, though analysts are still determining whether this reflects spending efficiency or insufficient resources.

stories.title: Pagos digitales: una oportunidad para ampliar la inclusión financiera en México

en.title: Digital payments: an opportunity to expand financial inclusion in Mexico
en.summary: Mexico has digital payment infrastructure capable of transforming its economy, requiring development of consumer confidence, interoperability, and adoption to reach more individuals and small businesses.

stories.title: México y Europa: La infraestructura como prueba de absorción

en.title: Mexico and Europe: Infrastructure as a test of absorption
en.summary: Mexico's infrastructure will serve as a key indicator for assessing whether the new economic relationship between Mexico and Europe translates commercial agreements into investment, local production, and economic growth.
